{"projectId":"9891734431591622481","sessionId":"13508367982825217208","outputComponents":[{"design":{"screens":[{"screenshot":{"name":"projects/9891734431591622481/files/33c76e6f5d1e407ebb84c3191b79423e","downloadUrl":"https://stitch.googleapis.com/v1/projects/9891734431591622481/files/33c76e6f5d1e407ebb84c3191b79423e:download"},"htmlCode":{"name":"projects/9891734431591622481/files/e0fc8368d68242c29331192128a4c392","downloadUrl":"https://stitch.googleapis.com/v1/projects/9891734431591622481/files/e0fc8368d68242c29331192128a4c392:download","mimeType":"text/html"},"id":"9e6ee44cd07643e9aea5392a35db96f8","generatedBy":"figaro_agent","width":"2560","height":"2048","title":"BICE LMS - Course Learning Interface","prompt":"Design the high-fidelity desktop (1440px) Course Learning Interface for lesson 'Power Query: Cleaning Messy Data' of the BICE platform.

Follow the exact 3-zone layout requested:

1. LEFT SIDEBAR (width 280px, fixed height scrollable, border-r border-slate-200 bg-white):
- Header: Back arrow button '< Back to Course', course title 'Advanced Excel Masterclass' in bold slate-900 with subtitle 'By CA Rohan Mehta'.
- Progress overview card: 'Course Progress 68%' with dual-color progress bar (indigo-600 / slate-100) and text '18 of 26 lessons completed'.
- Search lessons input box with search icon and placeholder 'Search lessons...'.
- Collapsible curriculum list:
  * Section 1: 'Excel Fundamentals' (collapsed) showing badge '5/6 done', chevron down.
  * Section 2: 'Advanced Formulas' (collapsed) showing badge '4/7 done', chevron down.
  * Section 3: 'Power Query' (EXPANDED, active section):
    - Header with section title 'Section 3: Power Query ETL' and '3/6 done', chevron up.
    - Lesson 1: 'Introduction to M-Code' - Green checkmark circle (completed), duration '14:20', subtle hover state.
    - Lesson 2: 'Extracting from Multi-File Folders' - Green checkmark circle (completed), duration '18:45'.
    - Lesson 3: 'Unpivoting Cross-tab Data' - Green checkmark circle (completed), duration '22:10'.
    - Lesson 4 (CURRENT ACTIVE LESSON): 'Power Query: Cleaning Messy Data' - Indigo play circle icon, highlighted row with bg-indigo-50/80 border-l-4 border-indigo-600 text-indigo-900 font-semibold, badge 'Now Playing', duration '28:10'.
    - Lesson 5: 'Custom Columns & Conditional Logic' - Gray outline circle (pending), duration '19:30'.
    - Lesson 6: 'Automating Scheduled Refreshes' - Small lock icon with red/slate tint (locked), duration '25:00', badge 'Locked'.
  * Section 4: 'Projects & Capstone' (collapsed) showing badge '2/4 done', chevron down.

2. CENTER ZONE (flex-1 main learning area, min-w-0 bg-slate-50/50 p-6 overflow-y-auto):
- Top navigation / breadcrumbs row:
  * Breadcrumb: 'Section 3: Power Query > Lesson 4: Cleaning Messy Data' in slate-500/slate-900.
  * Prev / Next controls: Button '< Previous Lesson' and 'Next Lesson >' with keyboard shortcut hints ('P' / 'N').
- Video Player Component (16:9 ratio, sleek dark border slate-900 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg relative bg-slate-950):
  * Rich high-resolution video screen mockup displaying realistic Excel Power Query editor UI (queries pane on left, data preview grid with messy transactions, unpivot columns ribbon, applied steps pane on right: Source, Promoted Headers, Changed Type, Filtered Rows).
  * Video watermark text overlay: Subtle diagonal semi-transparent watermark text repeated/centered across the video viewport: 'Rahul Sharma | rah***@gmail.com | ID 10234' with 25% opacity in white font.
  * Custom media player controls overlay bar at bottom:
    - Scrubber timeline showing 12:40 / 28:10 with indigo progress fill, buffer track, and scrubber thumb.
    - Left controls: Play/Pause button, 10s Rewind, 10s Fast-Forward, Volume icon with level slider, timestamp '12:40 / 28:10'.
    - Center/Right controls: Playback speed pill dropdown '1.5x', Quality pill '1080p HD', Closed Captions 'CC' toggle (active indigo), Picture-in-Picture icon, Fullscreen button. Explicitly NO download button.
- Below Player Content Area:
  * Title row: 'Power Query: Cleaning Messy Data' (H1 24px bold slate-900) with category badge 'Advanced ETL' in indigo-100 text-indigo-700 and 'Intermediate' level badge.
  * Lesson description paragraph: 'In this session, learn how to handle irregular header splits, inconsistent date formats, and trailing delimiter errors using native Power Query transformations. We review step-by-step cleaning pipelines without writing raw M-code syntax.'
  * Lesson Attachments row:
    - Label 'Lesson Attachments (2):'
    - File chip 1: 'powerquery-cheatsheet.pdf' (with PDF red icon, '2.4 MB', and download icon).
    - File chip 2: 'practice-dataset.xlsx' (with Excel green icon, '8.1 MB', and download icon).
  * Bottom Action Bar (card with border-t border-slate-200 pt-4 mt-6 flex justify-between items-center):
    - Left: Outlined secondary button '< Previous: Unpivoting Data'
    - Right: Indigo-600 primary button 'Mark as Completed & Continue' with check icon, and 'Autoplay Next' toggle switch.

3. RIGHT SIDEBAR (width 320px, fixed bg-white border-l border-slate-200 flex flex-col h-full):
- Tabs header: 3 tabs with underline indicator: 'Notes' (Active, indigo underline), 'Resources (2)', 'Q&A (2)'.
- Notes Tab Content (Active view):
  * Timestamp note chip button '+ Add note at 12:40' with indigo clock icon.
  * Textarea input box with placeholder 'Write your notes for this lesson... (auto-saved)' containing realistic user note:
    'Remember: Always convert dates to text first if parsing locale mismatches (e.g. DD/MM vs MM/DD) before invoking Table.TransformColumns. Split by delimiter at leftmost semicolon.'
  * Save note action row with 'Last saved 1m ago' status and 'Save Note' indigo button.
  * Past timestamped notes list:
    - Note item 1: Chip '05:12' (clickable jump to 05:12) - 'Promoting headers clears auto-generated column type detection.' with edit/delete icons.
    - Note item 2: Chip '09:34' - 'Reorder steps before heavy transformations to improve query fold cache.'
- Below Notes in sidebar:
  * Resources section preview: Clean cards for 'practice-dataset.xlsx' and 'powerquery-cheatsheet.pdf' with direct view/download actions.
  * Q&A preview item: 'Why does Unpivot Other Columns fail on dynamic null headers?' with 1 instructor answer badge 'Answered by CA Rohan Mehta'.
